subject: Guest travel: merchant mischarge and temporary credit request for onsite workshop
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@optimahealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Guest travel & corporate card hold for upcoming onsite

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from Optima ahead of next week's onsite: our speaker (Mike Reyes) booked his hotel through Optima's travel portal, but the hotel posted the authorization/settlement to a Redwood corporate card on file due to a merchant tokenization mix-up. The hotel has applied a $1,150 authorization hold to Redwood's card and it shows as "Redwood Inference" on the statement. We've uploaded the guest expense spreadsheet and boarding pass (attached).

Can Redwood either (A) request an immediate reversal with the hotel/processor, or (B) provide a temporary credit so Mike isn't out-of-pocket while we get the charge fixed? We also have several small guest stipends (parking, ride shares) that we'd like to reconfirm the process for.

Attached: expense_report_optima_guest.xlsx, boardingpass_mike_reyes.pdf, hotel_receipt_misapplied.png

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Jennings
Director, Events & Partnerships
Optima Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@optimahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guest travel & corporate card hold for upcoming onsite

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah — sorry for the mess.

Ben/Marissa: looping you in. Can Finance open a merchant dispute on the authorization and confirm whether we can issue a temporary vendor credit or an expedited reimbursement to Mike while Optima works with the hotel? If we go the temporary credit route, please confirm the accounting treatment so Optima doesn't get double-billed.

Sarah — can you confirm the hotel transaction date and the last 4 digits of the posted card on the charge line? Also confirm whether Optima would accept a one-time guest stipend (we can pre-authorize $200 for incidentals) vs. pushing a temporary ACH credit.

I'll mark this high priority so it gets processed before the onsite.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0124

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@optimahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guest travel & corporate card hold for upcoming onsite

Thanks Vanessa / Sarah.

Ben from Finance here. We can do two things in parallel:

1) Open a formal dispute with our payment processor for the $1,150 authorization. To do that we need: merchant name, transaction date, authorization ID if available, and the last 4 digits shown on the posted charge. Sarah — can you paste that line from the hotel confirmation or attach a screenshot?

2) We can issue a one-time expedited stipend to the guest (Mike) for up to $200 to cover incidentals while the dispute resolves. If you prefer a temporary ACH to Optima instead, we can do that but it requires AP approval and ~3 business days.

Marissa — do you approve a one-time $200 guest stipend for this event? If so I will route to Payments for overnight ACH to Mike's account (we will need routing/account or we can issue a prepaid card). If not, I'll follow the standard AP route.

I'll also flag this as a potential chargeback if the hotel doesn't cooperate; we should avoid double refunds.

Attachments referenced: none

— Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@optimahealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T18:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guest travel & corporate card hold for upcoming onsite

> Sarah — can you confirm the hotel transaction date and the last 4 digits of the posted card on the charge line?

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Transaction details below:
- Hotel: Harborview Suites (San Francisco)
- Transaction date: 2026-11-19
- Posted amount / auth: $1,150.00
- Posting shows: "REDWOOD INFERENCE *HAVBORV" with last 4 digits 8421
- Optima booking ref: OPT-WS-9981

Attached are the boarding pass and the guest expense packet. If issuing the $200 stipend to Mike is fastest, please do that and we'll follow up with the hotel for the reversal. If you need Mike's bank details for ACH, I can get them today — otherwise a prepaid card would be easiest.

Appreciate the help.

— Sarah

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Jennings <sarah.jennings@optimahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guest travel & corporate card hold for upcoming onsite

Approve $200 one-time guest stipend and overnight prepaid card issuance to Mike Reyes. Ben — please proceed with the stipend via our prepaid card vendor (CardSprint) and mark the transaction as "Guest Stipend — Optima" for reconciliation. Finance should also open the dispute with the processor using the data Sarah provided (auth last4=8421, date=2026-11-19).

Vanessa — please confirm Mike's preferred card delivery (physical pickup at the venue or mailing to the hotel) and whether Optima will accept an ACH to their corporate account for any remaining settlement. Sarah, if you can forward the hotel confirmation screenshot to payments@redwood.com that will speed the dispute.

Timeline: prepaid card issuance within 24 hours once Payments has the guest name; dispute submitted today and we'll update you within 48 hours on processor response.

Thanks — I'll keep this on my radar so it doesn't delay the onsite.

— Marissa Cole
Head, Events Programs (Ops)
Redwood Inference
